resources.string: Reads only supported TV launcher cards and detail pages so the selected title can be opened in an app you choose.
Open launcher recommendations in your preferred media app. Free, open source, and account-free.
The accessibility service is restricted to supported TV launchers. Selected titles are sent to Cinemeta for identification; no account or device identifier is collected.
